prior_year_events.impact_description: Increase in gross claims estimates for the 2013 underwriting year (adverse development) as evidenced by the claims development table

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 11.073m. During 2015 there was adverse prior-year development driven predominantly by the 2013 underwriting year, increasing gross claims estimates by approximately GBP 11.24m (strengthening). The movement is principally seen in casualty (third party liability) and property lines and reflects a combination of adverse claims development and recalibration of IBNR; reinsurance recoveries partially offset the net effect. Closing gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2015 were GBP 36.521m.
raw_causal_phrases: continuing deterioration in market conditions in many of the states or territories in which the syndicate writes business
reduced premium levels, which are reflective of current market conditions, platform build and reinsurance expenses

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (11.240m) was derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative incurred estimates) using the 2013 column (the only UW year older than the two most recent). There is no single explicit gross 'movement in prior years' line; narrative and a Net movement table exist (net amounts). The triangle and the 'significant movements' wording are used to infer gross/net impacts. Triangle and reconciliation cells are presented in thousands in the report. Confidence reflects calculation from presented triangle rather than an explicit single gross PYD disclosure.
